body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Haier presented its portable media player 'Rhapsody ibiza Theatre' at the CES 2009.
The ibiza Theatre supports music download service, audio books, podcasts and more from Rhapsody's extensive audio library.

The larger 2.4-inch touchscreen has high-definition capabilities and a precise picture that makes watching many different video formats possible. The built-in wireless Bluetooth capabilities for stereo Bluetooth headsets also make for a convenient movie viewing experience.

Available in 8GB or 16GB memory sizes, it comes with a longer lasting battery than ever before allowing for 30 hours of uninterrupted playback. It is expected to be available in 2Q, 2009, and suggested price is 109.99(USD) for 8G and 129.99(USD) for 16GB.
